name: Self-Learn
description: Enables the agent to autonomously create, update, and manage reusable skills from experience

enableCron.description: Register a gateway cron job that periodically reviews self-learned skills

cron.description: Cron expression for the periodic skill review (5-field standard cron)

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone for the cron expression (e.g. "America/Vancouver"). Defaults to UTC.

slackChannel.description: Optional Slack destination for the periodic review findings (e.g. "#emma-skills"). When unset, the review reply stays in the isolated cron session and is not announced. When set, the agent's summary is announced to this channel; HEARTBEAT_OK suppresses delivery.
